# BCa coverage re-run of the section 9.1 simulation (generated by `python -m polysafe.coverage`)

PREREGISTRATION D2.1, D2.1a. Same cohorts, grid, seed and simulated studies as section 9.1, BCa with 2,000 patient-level resamples per simulated study and the leave-one-patient-out jackknife; fixed out-of-fold predictions, no refitting. Apart from the reproduction check, every number below is read from `results/coverage_simulation.csv` and `results/coverage_mde.csv`.

**Same studies as 9.1.** The re-run's percentile bounds, estimates and clinical-only AUROCs reproduce `results/power_simulation_raw.csv.gz` (max absolute difference 9.99634e-17, checked during the run).

**Undefined intervals.** BCa failed (D2.1a: no interval) for 0 dAUROC, 0 clinical-only AUROC and 0 combined AUROC intervals; 0 resamples were dropped as undefined.

**Type I error at a true dAUROC of 0** (share of studies whose lower bound is above 0; nominal one-sided 2.5%): BCa 4.0% on average (max 6.5% in any cell); percentile 3.9% (max 6.5%) on the same studies.

**Coverage of the 95% dAUROC interval** over all cells: BCa 90.5%-98.0% (mean 94.3%), percentile 91.0%-98.0% (mean 94.2%). Clinical-only AUROC (true A0): BCa 91.0%-99.0%. Combined AUROC (true A0 + dAUROC): BCa 90.0%-99.5%.

**Primary cohort, measured prevalence 11.6%, A0 = 0.75:**

| rho | BCa dAUROC coverage (min-max over dAUROC) | type I BCa | type I percentile | 80%-power threshold BCa | percentile |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.6 | 93.5%-96.0% | 4.0% | 3.5% | 0.076 | 0.076 |
| 0.75 | 93.0%-95.5% | 4.5% | 3.5% | 0.062 | 0.061 |
| 0.9 | 92.5%-96.0% | 4.5% | 4.0% | 0.040 | 0.040 |
| 0.95 | 93.0%-96.0% | 4.5% | 3.5% | 0.029 | 0.029 |

Coverage over all cells of this cohort and prevalence (the D2.1a range): dAUROC BCa 92.5%-96.5%; clinical-only AUROC 98.5%-99.0%; combined AUROC 94.0%-99.5%. Per-cell values are in `results/coverage_simulation.csv`, thresholds for every A0 in `results/coverage_mde.csv`.
